summary: The team reviewed the management brief, confirming a June 1 launch and an €80,000 budget. They approved shipping the thermostat in matte white and rejected a Gold Edition for the initial launch. Prototype testing received strong user approval. Pricing for Europe was postponed pending a cost report. Action items were assigned for color samples, model evaluation, and the launch video.
discussion_points: Management brief: launch date and budget
